name: The Four-Source Convergence
description: Compromise confirmed by three engine-corroborated sources: memory (process injection posing as itself in lsass.exe), network (traffic contradicting the host's declared state), and disk (a beacon DLL with tampered timestamps posing as Windows Defender). A fourth source, TPM boot attestation, rules out pre-boot compromise as context — the current detector suite has no hardware-attestation category, so it isn't counted toward the engine's numeric corroboration.
devil_advocate: Each source alone could have a benign explanation, but the independent convergence points to the same actor and timeline. The TPM rules out pre-boot compromise.

custodyEvents.detail: EDR + network alerts correlated to one host.
custodyEvents.detail_es: Alertas de EDR y de red correlacionadas a un mismo host.

custodyEvents.detail: Memory image, pcap, disk image and TPM quote acquired.
custodyEvents.detail_es: Imagen de memoria, pcap, imagen de disco y quote del TPM adquiridos.

custodyEvents.detail: Deterministic engine ran over the acquired artifacts.
custodyEvents.detail_es: El motor determinista corrió sobre los artefactos adquiridos.

artifacts.description: PID 2244 injected into lsass.exe, presenting as the legitimate process while running injected code. Kernel structure anomaly confirmed.
artifacts.description_es: PID 2244 inyectado en lsass.exe. Kernel structure anomaly confirmado.

artifacts.description: DNS beacon every 300s ± 45s, consistent with Cobalt Strike's default beacon — the host has no declared reason to be contacting this domain at all.
artifacts.description_es: DNS beacon cada 300s ± 45s. Consistente con beacon default de Cobalt Strike.

artifacts.description: Beacon DLL found in System32 posing as Windows Defender, with file timestamps altered to match legitimate system files. Hash matches a known beacon.
artifacts.description_es: Beacon DLL encontrada en System32 haciéndose pasar por Windows Defender. Hash coincide con beacon conocido.

artifacts.description: TPM PCR0 and PCR7 valid. Boot integrity intact. The attack is post-boot, runtime injection. No markers: this artifact shows the ABSENCE of anomaly (a clean boot), which is context that rules out a rival hypothesis, not something any of the 5 anomaly-detectors can score.
artifacts.description_es: TPM PCR0 y PCR7 válidos. Boot integrity intacta. El ataque es post-boot, runtime injection.

peirce_chain.firstness: Four independent artifacts pointing to the same compromise.
peirce_chain.secondness: Low cross-correlation: these sources cannot have been fabricated together.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Cobalt Strike beacon with process injection confirmed. Reliable evidence.

demo_quote: Four independent sources converge in the story; three of them are what the engine's detector suite can actually score today. The TPM's clean reading is real corroboration in the forensic sense — it rules out a rival hypothesis — even though it doesn't move the engine's corroborationCount. That gap is worth naming honestly rather than papering over.
description_es: Compromiso confirmado por cuatro fuentes independientes: memory (process injection en lsass.exe), network (DNS beacon a C2), disk (beacon DLL con hash conocido) y TPM (boot integrity intacta). Baja correlación cruzada, alta confianza.
devil_advocate_es: Cada fuente por sí sola podría tener explicación benigna, pero la convergencia independiente apunta al mismo actor y timeline. El TPM descarta compromiso pre-boot.
demo_quote_es: Cuatro fuentes independientes convergen. Ninguna explica sola el caso, pero juntas forman una prueba que resiste la duda razonable.

peirce_chain_es.firstness: Cuatro artefactos independientes apuntando al mismo compromiso.
peirce_chain_es.secondness: Baja correlación cruzada: estas fuentes no pueden haber sido fabricadas juntas.
peirce_chain_es.thirdness: Cobalt Strike beacon con process injection confirmado. Evidencia confiable.
